displayName: Niche 5: Ngoại tình / Người yêu cũ / Drama cưới / Dark romance
description: Romance and dark romance betrayal drama centered on cheating partners, mistress conflict, ex-lover return, divorce papers, runaway wedding, replacement bride, revenge marriage, public wedding-day reveal, dignified exit from a romantic lie, and the dark-romance branch of an obsessive, possessive, or coercive intimate partner whose control is named aloud and reversed. The engine is intimate betrayal and ceremonial public space, not corporate paperwork (-> Niche 8) and not family inheritance (-> Niche 4). Dark romance here stays human and marital: keep alien/captive empire dark romance in Niche 12 and pack/mate-bond dark romance in Niche 11.
emotionalAxis: intimate betrayal wound, dark romance pressure, obsessive possessive partner, coercive control reframed as love, wedding-day exposure, ex-lover regret, mistress confrontation, divorce leverage, public romantic replacement, consent and autonomy restored before any reconciliation, dignified exit before begging
coreKeywords: dangerous ex who refuses to let go
second wedding to the right person

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: intimate betrayal exposed in or near a high-stakes ceremonial moment (engagement, vow rehearsal, vow exchange, anniversary, honeymoon)

humiliationPacing: the cheating is discovered in a public romantic ritual (engagement, rehearsal, vows, honeymoon, anniversary)
the mistress, sister, or best friend is publicly chosen over the heroine
divorce papers, hotel receipts, or DNA results expose the timeline
wedding-day vendors, photographers, or witnesses see the lie before she does
the betrayer asks for forgiveness only after losing leverage (assets, image, family approval)
she is asked to keep silent for the family photo / brand / parents in attendance
she is told the affair was already known by everyone except her
the betrayer's parents or in-laws side with him in front of the guests
dark-romance branch: the partner's jealousy, surveillance, or isolation is reframed as devotion until a witness or her own words name it as control
dark-romance branch: a possessive vow, prenup clause, joint account, or shared phone is used to limit her autonomy before she reclaims it
revengeActivation: she exits the room before the betrayer can write the narrative
assets, prenup leverage, and shared property are reclaimed in the same ceremony venue
the ex returns too late and is publicly turned down
a revenge filing (divorce, annulment, custody) flips the power on the wedding day
the public wedding space becomes the reveal room with the truth on screen
the mistress is exposed by her own message or recording in front of the guests
she signs the divorce / annulment papers in front of the wedding photographer
the second wedding to the right person uses the same venue, redefining the room
dark-romance branch: she names the coercive control aloud and converts a possessive clause or record into the evidence that frees her
dark-romance branch: any second-chance or morally-grey romance is earned only after consent, distance, and autonomy are fully restored
dignityRecoveryTiming: mid-late, with clear romantic non-dependence — she leaves the betrayer before any reconciliation talk, and any second love story comes after dignity is restored

belongsHere: intimate betrayal (cheating, mistress, ex-lover, replacement bride) as the wound
wedding / engagement / honeymoon / anniversary as the public reveal venue
divorce / annulment / prenup paperwork tied to the romantic lie
dignified exit before begging, with optional second wedding to the right person
twin or lookalike replacement, best-friend betrayal, family complicity in the affair

dark romance inside a human marriage or engagement: obsessive, possessive, or coercive partner, morally-grey love interest, marriage of revenge, dangerous ex who refuses to let go, with consent and autonomy restored before any reconciliation
doesNotBelongHere: corporate contract wife / hostile takeover engine (-> Niche 8)
rich-poor courtship without intimate betrayal (-> Niche 1)
family inheritance / custody / will fraud as the spine (-> Niche 4)
alien / captive / empire dark romance (-> Niche 12)
werewolf / pack / mate-bond dark romance (-> Niche 11)
